column1: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE PAYMENT OF  NATIONAL MINIMUM WAGE

column2: BY EMPLOYERS TO WORKERS AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

column2: (1) This Act may be cited as the National Minimum

column1: Wage of Workers Act, No. 3 of 2016.

column2: (2)  The  provisions  of  this  Act  shall  be  deemed,  for  all

column1: purposes to have come into operation on January 1, 2016.

column2: (1) The Commissioner-General shall be the competent

column1: authority for the purposes of this Act.

column2: (2) The competent authority may delegate to any officer

column1: of the Department of Labour any power, function or duty
conferred or imposed on, or assigned to, such authority by

column2: (1)  The  national  minimum  monthly  wage  for  all

column1: workers  in  any  industry  or  service  shall  be  ten  thousand
rupees and the national minimum daily wage of a worker

column2: (2) Notwithstanding the provisions of any other written

column1: law, no employer in any industry or service shall pay to any
worker  employed  by  him  a  wage  which  is  less  than  the
national  minimum  monthly  or  daily  wage  specified  in
subsection (1), as the case may be.
